_doc: Data of the trap classifier (crash_ratchet.py --classify and rust_panic_ratchet.py --classify, p10-stability-205, Q21). TrapClassifier.classify's docstring has the rules and their order; this file holds their data. paths: [{glob, class (input|invariant), reason}], matched by fnmatch on the repo-relative path (* also matches /), the first match decides. entries: {lang: {name: regex}} matched on a function's signature (from `func`/`init`/`fn` to its body's `{`): a decode entry point (Q14). byte_reads: {lang: {name: regex}} matched on a function's body or the hit's line: the code reads peer or file bytes. A function that matches either, and every function of the same file it calls by name, is input-reachable.

paths.reason: the cmux.rd/1 wire formats: every type here is decoded from a peer's datagrams (lib.rs: 'Wire formats of the cmux remote desktop protocol'); an operand is a peer's bytes unless a mark says otherwise
versioned wire types read from external machine providers over newline-delimited JSON
a fuzz target exists to feed outside bytes to a decoder
